readings: Using films with rental_duration of at least 5 days, group the films by rating. For each rating, show the rating, the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration across films with a nonmissing ratio, the number of films in the group, and that average divided by a benchmark. Calculate the benchmark as the unweighted mean of these per-rating averages across all ratings, excluding missing averages. If the benchmark is missing, return no rows. Leave all values unrounded.

Using films with rental_duration greater than 5 days, group the films by rating. For each rating, show the rating, the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration across films with a nonmissing ratio, the number of films in the group, and that average divided by a benchmark. Calculate the benchmark as the unweighted mean of these per-rating averages across all ratings, excluding missing averages. If the benchmark is missing, return no rows. Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS value
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.average_ratio,
  r.film_count,
  r.average_ratio / b.value AS relative_to_benchmark
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_ratio,
  film_count,
  avg_ratio / value AS relative_to_benchmark
FROM rating_averages
CROSS JOIN benchmark
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
